theorem_title: Batch source construction is bounded by compact capacity
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceBatchProgram.time_bound {count h J cut : ℕ} (hcut : cut ≤ J*(464*h)) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceBatch.time count h J cut ≤
      (count+1)*(_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceRetainedProgram.factor h J+720)*(_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.downsetCap (J*(464*h)) cut+1) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
For natural count $N$, dimensions $h,J$, and cutoff $c\le464hJ$, $$\operatorname{batchTime}(N,h,J,c)\le(N+1)(\operatorname{factor}(h,J)+720)(\operatorname{downsetCap}(464hJ,c)+1).$$

This batch estimate retains the occurrence count and compact capacity factors in source-construction accounting.
